summary.text: Barbara Ballard is a Democratic state representative who has represented Kansas House District 44 since 1993 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. A former teacher and University of Kansas dean of students, she serves as ranking minority member of the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Ballard earned a B.Me.Ed. from Webster College and master's and Ph.D. degrees from Kansas State University.
Her professional experience includes working as an elementary school teacher, dean of students at the University of Kansas, and director of the Emily Taylor Women's Resource Center.
Ballard served on the Lawrence Public Schools board from 1985 to 1993, and assumed office in the Kansas House in 1993.
She began serving as Minority Caucus Chair in the 2015 session.

During the 2025-2026 session she served on the House Interstate Cooperation, Social Services Budget, and Robert G. (Bob) Bethell Joint Committee on Home and Community Based Services and KanCare Oversight committees, and as ranking minority member of the House Legislative Budget and Appropriations committees.
